judge.rationale: The candidate only generated the TDD 'red bar' phase (`.lore/dod.md`, `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`, and two failing acceptance test files) and stopped before writing any implementation code. Neither `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` nor `package.json` (adding `ajv`) was modified, so all the newly added tests fail and the feature does not exist. It also missed the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`. Furthermore, the test file names (`*.acceptance.test.ts`) do not match the exact paths specified in the acceptance criteria (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`).
